description: This PHP class, HashingStream, is a decorator for stream objects that calculates a rolling hash of the stream data as it is read. It implements the StreamInterface and uses traits to extend functionality.

classes.name: HashingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that reads data from a wrapped stream, updates a hash with the data, and provides hash completion callback on EOF.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream, hash, and optional callback.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, updates the hash, and calls callback upon reaching EOF.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Resets the hash when seeking to the beginning of the stream.
